# Discussion

implications.

## Interpretation of our Findings

Discuss what the per-target results mean.

## Comparison with Previous Studies

Contrast your multi-participant, grouped-cross-validation results with the

## Implications for the Academic Literature / Future Research

Larger samples, controlled conditions, alternative HRV markers, and
explicit environmental controls.

## Limitations

Note the absence of a ground-truth measure, the small sample, the reused
stimulus, and the lack of sham / shielding controls.
